d: South Africa have made a statement of their own. After winning the World Test Championship in 2025, Temba Bavuma's side faced questions over whether that triumph was a one-off. Their series against Australia provided the perfect test. Despite losing the opening match, the Proteas fought back to win 2-1, with Bavuma's magnificent 179 in the second Test turning the contest around. They have reclaimed the number one spot in the ICC Test rankings and answered those who doubted their credentials.
